svg.title: SmartCommute — UML use-case diagram
svg.desc: Actors, use cases (UCN_SC_E001–E028) and their relationships for the SmartCommute web system.
svg.text: use cases UCN_SC_E001 – E028 (E025 is unassigned)
Association — actor takes part in the use case
Association to an external system the use case depends on
«extend» / «include» — arrow points at the base / included use case
Generalisation — role is a specialisation of Authenticated User
